text_block_list.text: Sigh... They really take it out of you...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I've only been wearing them for a bit,
but my legs
are all wobbly! Heels are the
worst...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Hm... Maybe I should take a quick
grown-up
break before I head to the
next shop.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
That sundae looks so good! ☆ And the
toppings
are really cute! Guess I'll take
my break here.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Welcome! Oh, that sundae is very
popular with
our younger customers.
text_block_list.name: Cafe Staff

text_block_list.text:
Uh... Never mind! It looks really good,
but I'm a
grown-up!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
